openQuestions: src/design/css.test.ts (R2) pinned the old @fontsource imports, so swapping them broke it. I rewrote only its fonts.css describe block to check the subset faces and the new fallback order. Please ratify this as part of the fonts.css grant; WP-26 may touch the same file.

Linux/Android serif fallback (RULINGS: small-phone CLS): with no token change I could make, each 'Instrument Serif Fallback' style now has three faces with the same descriptors (DejaVu Serif, Noto Serif, then Georgia). Chromium tries the last face first and skips one whose local() fonts are all missing, which I confirmed here: CLS at 360x640 went from 0.039 to 0.0005. Firefox and WebKit order is not verified (not installed); Android needs the G5 phone check. Noto metrics were measured from @fontsource/noto-serif fetched with npm pack into the scratchpad, not installed. Sans on Android (Roboto, no Arial) is untuned.

/fonts/* has no Cache-Control rule in scripts/headers.ts (R10), so it gets Netlify's default revalidation. That is fine for size, but R10 may want an explicit rule. The files are unhashed by design: stable URLs for the preloads and troika.

credits.html and LICENSES/THIRD_PARTY.txt were generated by a scratch script (not committed; no owned path for it). A dependency bump would make them stale. A scripts/credits.ts under an R0 grant would keep them in sync.

Visual baselines: subsetting keeps outlines, metrics and layout features, and baselines are captured after document.fonts.ready, so I expect no screenshot change. CI is the authority; not compared locally.
notes: Environment: this container ships Chromium 1243 under /opt/pw-browsers, not 1194, so @playwright/test 1.56.1 failed to launch it (the build's PDF step broke). I added local-only symlinks /opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194 and chromium_headless_shell-1194 pointing at the 1243 builds. Nothing in the repo changed; CLAUDE.md's environment note is out of date.

U+FFFD is kept in the Plex subsets so the glyf table never ends on an empty glyph. Without it, fontkit (used by the placard and kit metric tests) read past the table for the space of an ASCII-only Plex subset.
npm run fonts is deterministic: two runs give byte-identical files.
